name: TikTok Shop Creator
install: cd backend && npm install && cd ../proxy && npm install

terminals.name: proxy
terminals.description: Zero-dependency CORS proxy for the browser-key model (root site, gh-pages, Android apps). Forwards /api/generate to api.anthropic.com using the per-request x-api-key-fwd header. Listens on http://localhost:3001.

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && PORT=3002 ALLOWED_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8000 node server.js
terminals.description: Express backend for the server-key model (frontend/). Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment and exposes POST /api/generate plus GET /health. Listens on http://localhost:3002. Set the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret to enable live generation.

terminals.name: static-site
terminals.description: Serves the static web clients from the repo root: root app http://localhost:8000/index.html (uses the proxy), frontend http://localhost:8000/frontend/index.html (set Backend URL to http://localhost:3002), and gh-pages http://localhost:8000/gh-pages/index.html.
